description: This file contains internal comparison functions and constants for the testify/assert package, including comparison logic for various data types and assertion functions like Greater, Less, Positive, and Negative.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Performs comparison between two objects of a specified reflect.Kind, returning a compareResult and a boolean indicating if comparison was successful.

methods.name: Greater
methods.description: Asserts that the first element is greater than the second.

methods.name: GreaterOrEqual
methods.description: Asserts that the first element is greater than or equal to the second.

methods.name: Less
methods.description: Asserts that the first element is less than the second.

methods.name: LessOrEqual
methods.description: Asserts that the first element is less than or equal to the second.

methods.name: Positive
methods.description: Asserts that the element is positive.

methods.name: Negative
methods.description: Asserts that the element is negative.

methods.name: compareTwoValues
methods.description: Helper function to compare two values with allowed comparison results and handle assertion failure.

methods.name: containsValue
methods.description: Checks if a slice of compareResult contains a specific value.
